reuse.why: Adds findWeekdayOccurrence and uses it in getNextDate, but getUpcomingDates writes its own weekday filter loop instead of using it, and schedule-template re-derives the daily rule itself.

duplication.why: The 'daily + skipWeekend means drop weekends' decision is written three times (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, schedule-template's movesWeekend), each in a different shape.

placement.why: The core rule sits in shared/schedules.ts, but server/schedules/app.ts and budget/schedule-template.ts each keep their own frequency branching rather than delegating to it.

scope.why: Edits only the weekend-handling paths, the frequency passthrough in parseRecurDate, and tests.

maintainability.why: Passing movesWeekend into getNextDate's noSkipWeekend parameter is a confusing inversion, and the daily rule now has three independent implementations to keep consistent.

bypasses_abstraction.where: getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts filters weekend days itself instead of using findWeekdayOccurrence/getNextDate, and schedule-template.ts computes its own movesWeekend flag.

disguised_duplication.where: The daily weekend-skip decision is reshaped at each site: a helper call in getNextDate, an inline loop with isWeekend in getUpcomingDates, and an inverted movesWeekend flag in schedule-template.

one_place.where: The rule is decided separately in shared/schedules.ts getNextDate, server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList.
